result.title: DRaGAN: Dynamic Graph Attention Network for Multi-Radar Point Cloud Encoding in Automotive Radar Perception
result.comment: Accepted to 2027 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII)
result.summary: Radar represents a key modality for weather-robust perception. Unlike optical sensors such as camera and LiDAR, radar can penetrate fog, rain and snow due to its longer wavelength, and recent hardware advances have steadily improved its spatial resolution, thus making it increasingly relevant for autonomous systems. While processing raw radar data requires substantial memory computation, most existing work has focused on preprocessed point-cloud data similar to LiDAR. However, the sparse radar points and sensor-relative anisotropy make LiDAR-oriented encoders suboptimal. To address this problem, we present DRaGAN, a dynamic graph attention network for multi-radar point clouds. DRaGAN introduces a sensor-relative Fourier encoding of angle and range to capture fixed-aperture radar characteristics, gated short- and long-range hub nodes along each sensor's line of sight for efficient local-global message passing, and attention-guided dynamic rewiring that prunes weak edges and adds a bounded number of latent connections restricted to two-hop neighborhoods. This reduces the number of processed edges in deeper layers while preserving representation quality. On TruckScenes, DRaGAN improves test NDS by 10.10 points over the evaluated RadarGNN baseline and reduces the reported model FLOP count by 63.7%. This trade-off includes an increase in model latency from 40 to 53.16 ms and in trainable parameters from 1.2M to 1.7M on the evaluated implementations. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/chr-is-tof/DRaGAN.

AI.brief_summary: 提出用于车载多雷达点云编码的 DRaGAN，通过传感器相对的角—距傅里叶编码、沿视线的短/长程 hub 节点以及注意力引导的动态重连，实现更高效的局部—全局消息传递。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文属 3D 感知编码而非推理，但「剪除弱边并加入有限数量 latent 连接」的动态重连机制，可能可供核查 LVR 中随深度自适应调整内部状态连接结构与计算量的做法。
